name: theta-chain-panel-index
notes: The panel of chain-day features of the index root SPX for H6 (ADR-0265 Amendment 5): run-theta-chain-panel.json with the index tier (/home/russell/data/thetadata/parquet-v2/options-index/theta), the single root SPX and none of the stock gates (no first-quote file, no census). Same features, same targets (30 and 90 days), same rate table, sealed at 2026-01-01. READ-ONLY on the Parquet tree. Run from children/index_options after the index tier has landed and been exported: nice -n 10 python -m dskit.pipeline run configs/run-theta-chain-panel-index.json --asof 2025-12-31. Register panel/ as a localblobs source (theta-chain-panel-index) and record its snapshot pin with theta_hypotheses set-pin panel_index <hash>.

outputs.notes: A new directory beside the other research runs; nothing is written under /home/russell/data/thetadata. Excluded from the identity hash.

chain.notes: The ThetaData daily chain from the Parquet export tree, every root, symbol by symbol with dates ascending, projected to the ten fields the features read; the newest-acquired copy of a (symbol, date) unit wins. Lazy, re-iterable, read-only. The panel node asks it for one root at a time (select), so a root's files are read when that root is built and not before.

panel.notes: One feature run per root (the root's rows alone), one footer-checked file per root, then the per-date cut. max_symbol_rows 40,000,000 holds a root of up to about 2.4 GB packed (about 61 B a row) and refuses a bigger one (an index weekly root is about 75 M rows: run those in a lighter-target document). The census columns are the development-years liquidity tercile and median, carried as given; the census run must have finished before this one (a missing census file refuses). Rerun to pick up newly landed snapshots: unchanged roots are skipped. census_asof 2021-01-01 is the census's liquidity_end_before: the tercile and development median are written only on rows dated from it on and are null before (a number computed from 2016-2020 must not sit on a 2016 row). The stale_spot column flags days whose vendor price disagrees with the parity forward (spot and straddle_ratio are then null).

summary.notes: evidence.md renders the roots built / skipped / empty, the rows and dates, the status counts per target, the quote exclusions and the reader counters.

rates_raw.notes: The FRED 3-month constant-maturity Treasury yield (DGS3MO, percent, dated by the observation date, '.' on a holiday) from the index_options onboarding root, read-only. The series runs to 2026-09, so the node below drops 2026 before anything joins it.

rates.notes: Sealed period and holidays: a 2026 observation never reaches the features node (which also refuses one), and a '.' (no print) is not a rate. The 2026 rows are parsed by the reader above and dropped here; the series is a macro rate, not option data.
